content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Motion control motors and drives for industrial equipment makers, not semiconductor chips for consumer device makers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients and additives for formulators; no chip design or electronics business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Automotive aftermarket replacement parts sold to retailers; not fabless chip design for device makers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of electronic components and fasteners; it resells parts rather than designing proprietary chips."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, materials and fibers made in its own plants; different products and customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Digital contract manufacturer of custom prototype parts; it makes mechanical parts, not designing integrated circuits."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Precision bearings for aerospace and industrial machinery; mechanical components with different products and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Vehicle locks, keys and access systems sold to automakers; mechanical and access products, not semiconductors."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Medical devices sold to hospitals; regulated healthcare products with no overlap with chip design."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Industrial hardware, locks and metal castings made in owned plants; mechanical products, not electronics."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes semiconductor manufacturing equipment sold to chip fabs; shares an industry but sells tools, not chips."}]}
